Subsurface Mooring - Shipping Safety Control Zone 13
Subsurface mooring deployed in 71 53.577N 080 51.373W at 071306 UTC Jul 2026. Top of mooring 0.4m from the seabed, depth of water 12m. 
This mooring will remain deployed until the end of the 2027 navigational season.
